args.sql:
WITH EquipmentCount AS (
    SELECT 
        l.locationregistry,
        COUNT(e.equipmentcode) AS equipment_count
    FROM 
        location l
    JOIN 
        equipment e ON l.loceqref = e.equipmentcode
    GROUP BY 
        l.locationregistry
),
RenewableData AS (
    SELECT 
        t.thermaleqref,
        SUM(
            (
                renewablemetrics->'solar'->>'output_w'::float + 
                renewablemetrics->'wind'->>'output_w'::float
            ) * 
            (CASE WHEN powergridstatus = 'Connected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS total_renewable_power
    FROM 
        thermalsolarwindandgrid t
    WHERE 
        renewablemetrics->'solar'->>'output_w' IS NOT NULL AND 
        renewablemetrics->'wind'->>'output_w' IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 
        t.thermaleqref
),
EnergyClassification AS (
    SELECT 
        p.pwrbatteqref,
        CASE 
            WHEN powersource ILIKE '%Solar%' THEN 'High'
            WHEN powersource ILIKE '%Wind%' THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS energy_classification
    FROM 
        powerbattery p
)

SELECT 
    l.locationtype,
    l.stationname,
    ec.equipment_count,
    (rd.total_renewable_power / NULLIF(pb.powerconsumptionw, 0)) * 100 AS renewable_reliance_percent,
    rd.total_renewable_power,
    ec.energy_classification
FROM 
    location l
JOIN 
    EquipmentCount ec ON l.locationregistry = ec.locationregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    RenewableData rd ON l.loceqref = rd.thermaleqref
LEFT JOIN 
    powerbattery pb ON l.loceqref = pb.pwrbatteqref
LEFT JOIN 
    EnergyClassification ec ON l.loceqref = ec.pwrbatteqref
ORDER BY 
    l.stationname;

RenewableData AS (
    SELECT 
        t.thermaleqref,
        SUM(
            (
                (renewablemetrics->'solar'->>'output_w')::float + 
                (renewablemetrics->'wind'->>'output_w')::float
            ) * 
            (CASE WHEN powergridstatus = 'Connected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS total_renewable_power
    FROM 
        thermalsolarwindandgrid t
    WHERE 
        (renewablemetrics->'solar'->>'output_w')::float IS NOT NULL AND 
        (renewablemetrics->'wind'->>'output_w')::float IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 
        t.thermaleqref
),
EnergyClassification AS (
    SELECT 
        p.pwrbatteqref,
        CASE 
            WHEN powersource ILIKE '%Solar%' THEN 'High'
            WHEN powersource ILIKE '%Wind%' THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS energy_classification
    FROM 
        powerbattery p
)

SELECT 
    l.locationtype,
    l.stationname,
    ec.equipment_count,
    (rd.total_renewable_power / NULLIF(pb.powerconsumptionw, 0)) * 100 AS renewable_reliance_percent,
    rd.total_renewable_power,
    ec.energy_classification
FROM 
    location l
JOIN 
    EquipmentCount ec ON l.locationregistry = ec.locationregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    RenewableData rd ON l.loceqref = rd.thermaleqref
LEFT JOIN 
    powerbattery pb ON l.loceqref = pb.pwrbatteqref
LEFT JOIN 
    EnergyClassification ec ON l.loceqref = ec.pwrbatteqref
ORDER BY 
    l.stationname;
